name: Woodlands Park
description: A 15-acre park between Gravesend and Northfleet with a children's play area, outdoor gym, basketball court and a sensory garden. Dogs are not allowed in the play area, and the park is locked in the evening.

sources.label: Gravesham Borough Council: parks and play areas
